passed_test_assertions: The exact synthetic request reached the native Chat input before the actual configured HTTP model request.
The model proposed memory_save; native review matched the exact operation, kind, quotation, content and keywords before approval.
No receipt or memory note existed before the native approval tap.
Approval produced the expected receipt, one note and a nonempty model answer without a Chat or learning error.
The real Memory list contained exactly one matching saved item.
The native undo removed the note and saved item without a learning error.
App termination and relaunch reused the isolated encrypted namespace; the item remained absent and pending memory remained empty.
